title: Factorization of a product expectation
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets, and let $f\colon A\to\mathbb R$ and $g\colon B\to\mathbb R$. Under the uniform distribution on $A\times B$, the expected value of $f(a)g(b)$ is the product of the uniform expectations of $f$ on $A$ and $g$ on $B$.
